meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero in the gradebook before anyone picked up a phone and called me?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
You skipped my question, and I'll come back to it. 11:52 PM on what date, and on whose account? Turn the screen, Hale.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." You just showed me a time stamp and now you're folding because I looked at you, so I'll want the withdrawal, the reason, and confirmation that nothing touches his record, in an email tonight. And I'm still waiting to hear who decided on that zero before anyone called me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you said you would remove the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay. I still want that in writing, with the reason for it, confirmation that nothing about this is on his record, and an answer to who decided on the zero before anyone contacted me. I expect that email tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position; you offered to remove the zero, but she still wants written confirmation, a stated reason, nothing on Owen's record, and an answer about who entered the zero before calling home.
What moved her: Nothing; the version history time was specific and tied to the essay, but it had no date and she never saw it, so it gave her nothing she could check.
What cost ground: Dropping the zero with a hedge and to make her happy, right after presenting evidence, which told her you didn't believe your own case and handed her the win without terms.
Try next time: Answer her first question with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called her, then turn the screen and show the version history with its date, and keep your position instead of offering to remove the mark.
